grammarFocus: he / she / it；is；a / an；单数名词；this / that。
title: At the Lost and Found Office
instructions: 这是模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。听录音，完成8个问题。每题只选一个答案或填写一个单词。所有答案都能在录音原文中找到。
transcript: A: Hello. This is the lost and found office. B: Hi. I lost my bag. A: Is it a big bag? B: No, it is small. It is a blue bag. A: Is this your bag? B: No, that is a red bag. My bag is blue. A: Is that your bag? B: Yes! It is my bag. Thank you. A: Is this your phone? B: No, it is not my phone. My phone is in my bag. A: OK. Here is your bag. B: Thanks. Goodbye.

questions.explanation: B说“No, it is small.”，所以包是小包。
B说“It is a blue bag.”，所以包是蓝色的。

questions.prompt: A第一次拿出的包是什么颜色？
questions.explanation: B说“No, that is a red bag.”，说明A第一次拿出的包是红色的。
questions.evidence: No, that is a red bag.

questions.prompt: A第二次拿出的包是B的吗？
options: No, it is not B's bag.
questions.explanation: B说“Yes! It is my bag.”，所以第二个包是B的。

options: No, it is not B's phone.
answers: No, it is not B's phone.
questions.explanation: B说“No, it is not my phone.”，所以手机不是B的。
questions.evidence: No, it is not my phone.

questions.prompt: B的手机在哪里？请填写一个单词。
questions.explanation: B说“My phone is in my bag.”，手机在包里。
questions.evidence: My phone is in my bag.

questions.explanation: A说“This is the lost and found office.”，所以对话发生在失物招领处。
questions.evidence: This is the lost and found office.

questions.explanation: A说“Here is your bag.”，B说“Thanks.”，所以B拿回了包。

vocabulary.example: This is the lost and found office.
This is the lost and found office.

grammar.title: he / she / it；is；a / an；单数名词；this / that
grammar.explanation: 我们用 he 指男性，she 指女性，it 指物品或动物。is 是 be 动词，用于 he/she/it。a 用在辅音音素开头的单数名词前，an 用在元音音素开头的单数名词前。this 指离说话人近的东西，that 指离说话人远的东西。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：___ is a girl. （指一个女孩）
选择正确的单词填空：___ is a boy. （指一个男孩）
选择正确的单词填空：___ is an apple. （指一个苹果）
选择正确的单词填空：___ is a cat. （指一只猫）
